summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K disclosing an open-market repurchase of 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,133.76 each, totaling approximately MXN 56.7 million (excluding fees and VAT). The buyback was executed under the authorization granted at the April 28, 2026 ordinary shareholders' meeting, with Citi México Casa de Bolsa as the executing broker. Following the transaction, 110,667,402 Series A shares remain outstanding and 1,634,351 shares are held in treasury. This represents a routine capital return program execution rather than a transformative corporate event.
